1. Visit  https://www.denovosoftware.com/RegisterForSiteLicense/?SignupCode=UMGCCC+FCSS  

2. Register and create De Novo Software Account Credentials.  

3. You will receive the approval email within one day.  

4. Download at:  https://denovosoftware.com/full-access/download-landing/ 

5. Launch the installer. Choose “Stand Alone” when prompted.  

6. Configure: Run FCS Express 7. Follow the wizard:  

1st option “Automatically through this wizard, I already have a De Novo Software account”.  

Enter your De Novo Software Account credentials.  

Choose configuration file for your Flow Cytometry site license.  

Complete the wizard and FCS Express 7 will launch.
